```{r}

## library to inspect objects
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(rlang)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
```

[Q. Difference between `geom_path()` and `geom_line()`]{.question} `geom_path` connects in the order the points appear.
Both recognize `linetype`

[Q. Difference between `geom_rect()` and `geom_tile()`?]{.question} `geom_rect()` has `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax` whereas `geom_tile()` 
measures coordinates from the center of the rectangle. It has `x`, `y`, `width`, `height`. `geom_raster()` is a [fast special case]{.warning} of `geom_tile()`

(@) `geom_area()` is a good way to color area below the plot.


```{r}
df <- data.frame(
  x = c(3 ,1, 5),
  y = c(2,4,6),
  label = c("a", "b", "c")
)

df |>
  ggplot(aes(x, y, label = label)) +
  geom_area(color = "gray", alpha = 0.7)
```
